summary.text: Ronald Ryckman is a Republican member of the Kansas Senate representing District 38 (Meade County), and the Legislature's member page lists service in the Senate since 2021.
Ronald Ryckman is listed as a vice chair of the Local Government, Transparency and Ethics Committee.

paragraphs.text: According to the same page, Ronald Ryckman served in the House (2011–2016) before the current service in the Senate that began in 2021.
Ronald Ryckman is listed as a member of the Local Government, Transparency and Ethics Committee, the Agriculture and Natural Resources Committee, the Commerce Committee and the Judiciary Committee.
